narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Quiet Control Room"**

gtmworks is an Operate-mode product: people direct agents, approve their work and read the numbers (`PRODUCT.md`). The look serves that job and gets out of the way. It is Paperclip's UI, a neutral monochrome workspace where white cards sit on an off-white canvas, colour is rare and always means something (a board stage, an agent's role, a label, an error). Existing screens are refined inside this identity, never redesigned.

The look is Paperclip's UI at commit `dc1adb7209bf8077983fdde8c1e8ab18405403b7` (`ui/`). Copy its code, colours, spacing, radius, Inter and Paper Mono fonts, Tailwind stack, Radix/shadcn primitives, shell, controls, menus, dialogs and motion. The former prototype and its motion limits are retired. `components/paperclip/` contains the scoped copies; `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` identifies every file, its source, adaptations and licences. Keep the MIT notice until the last substantial copy is replaced.

Only existing screens are ported: sign-in, company shell, Home, Work board/list/calendar, card creation/detail, Inbox, Agents and settings (including language and members), company selection and existing empty routes. Do not add Paperclip's org chart, costs, budgets, terminal, AI execution or other products. The database, permission rules, API and runs remain governed by the ADRs.
keyCharacteristics: Paperclip at the pinned commit is the stated source of the look: its code, colours, spacing, radius, fonts, Tailwind stack, Radix/shadcn primitives, shell, controls, menus, dialogs and motion are copied, not re-drawn.
Neutral greys carry the whole interface; the only hues are the four board-stage tones, the agents' role identity colours, the user-chosen label colours and the destructive red.
One radius knob (8px) sets the corner ladder; Tailwind's 4px unit underlies the spacing, with a few product gaps between its steps (see Layout).
English-first with a complete Modern Standard Arabic mirror: the layout flips at the inline axis, authored content keeps its own direction.
Every interactive target is at least 44px on mobile, contrast meets WCAG AA, and reduced motion is respected.
Every departure from Paperclip is listed with its reason in "Deviations and their reasons" below.

rules.name: The Neutral Canvas Rule
rules.body: Chrome is grey. A hue appears only as a board-stage tone, a role identity, a user-chosen label colour or the destructive red of an error or destructive action; never as decoration or as a brand accent.

rules.name: The Two Scopes Rule
rules.body: Shell surfaces use the Coordinator tokens; anything rendered in a portal uses the root tokens, exactly as upstream does. Do not copy a shell colour into a portal or the reverse.

rules.name: The Defined-But-Dormant Rule
rules.body: A dark theme is defined in `components/paperclip/theme.css` (the `.dark` scope) but no code applies the class, so the shipped look is light only. The chart tokens `--chart-1` to `--chart-5` are mapped but have no values; bar charts fall back to the foreground colour (`app/globals.css`, `.bar-track i`). Neither is a designed feature to extend without a decision.

rules.name: The Language Font Rule
rules.body: Vazirmatn is used for Arabic only; English stays on Inter. Digits keep Western order in both languages.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Identifiers Rule
rules.body: Paper Mono marks ids and navigation group labels, never body copy.

rules.name: The Logical Axis Rule
rules.body: Prefer inline-start and inline-end properties to left and right, so one stylesheet serves both languages. Physical coordinates stay only where they are already a mirrored pair or a centring idiom: the copied dialog centres with `left: 50%` and a -50% translate (`components/paperclip/ui/dialog.tsx`), and the native select places its caret from the left or the right according to `:dir(rtl)` (`components/paperclip/theme.css`).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface is flat at rest. A shadow answers a state (hover, pickup, overlay), with one standing exception: the copied outline button and text input carry the Hint shadow at rest.

dos: **Do** read a value from `components/paperclip/theme.css` or the copied component before inventing one; the pinned Paperclip commit is the source.
